authorityReview.evidence: This payable deposit accepts native ETH from the caller and a caller-selected ETHx receiver. The inspected manager checks protocol minDeposit/maxDeposit and pause/configuration state, computes shares from its configured exchange-rate path, then calls the fixed ETHx token mint for receiver and shares. The function accepts no arbitrary callee or calldata and does not itself prove a later withdrawal workflow. Native value is the ordinary function argument; no additional platform-native financial cap, receiver, feed, or balance gate is introduced. Protocol amount, oracle/exchange-rate, token, pause, or governance conditions may revert. The dated source/address role and ABI do not establish current proxy/storage/configuration, funding or outcome.
